en.headline: SmarTone offers 10GB free data to monthly subscribers after outage
en.dek: SmarTone said it will automatically credit an extra 10GB of local data to all monthly plan customers, including Birdie users, in the next billing cycle following Thursday’s network disruption.
body: SmarTone said on Friday it would provide a one-off extra 10GB of local data to all SmarTone and Birdie monthly plan subscribers as a goodwill gesture after Thursday afternoon’s network instability.

The disruption began around 2.30pm on 26 November in some areas, with users reporting loss of service for calls and data. The company said affected services began returning to normal by 3.45pm and were fully restored later that afternoon. Customers do not need to apply; the data will be credited automatically in the next billing cycle subject to terms.

SmarTone apologised again for the inconvenience and said its engineering team had conducted a full review. It will continue monitoring the network to strengthen stability. The Office of the Communications Authority has asked for a report on the incident.

zh.headline: 數碼通向月費客戶提供10GB本地數據補償
zh.dek: 數碼通表示，就周四網絡不穩事件，將向所有數碼通及自由鳥月費計劃客戶在下一個賬單月自動存入額外10GB本地數據。
body: 數碼通周五宣布，就周四下午網絡服務不穩定事件，向所有數碼通及自由鳥月費計劃客戶提供一次性額外10GB本地數據作為補償。
事故於11月26日約下午2時半在部分地區開始，有用戶反映無法通話及上網。公司表示受影響服務於下午3時45分起陸續恢復，其後全面回復正常。客戶毋須申請，數據將於下一個賬單月自動存入，具體以條款為準。
數碼通再次致歉，並指工程團隊已全面檢視事件，將持續監察網絡以加強穩定性。通訊事務管理局辦公室已要求營辦商就事故成因及改善措施提交報告。
